{{Top|leg}}
'''Yusko''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Yusko noted some of the downsides of using a [[Fingerprint masque/Legends|fingerprint masque]], such as the lack of genetic data that gave away the fact that the print left behind by the masque was a fake.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
